# Jenvu AI

> Institutional-grade AI trading intelligence for Gold (XAU/USD), FX, Crypto and Indices. Jenvu combines an ICT/SMC signal engine, a voice agent, and a live annotated chart desk to deliver A+ setups with multi-timeframe bias.
